verdict.rationale: Pulley documents the building blocks of this story as its own features: stock option templates, equity plan capacity for grants, e-signing with grant acceptance tracking, interactive offer letters, board management under compliance, and an in-house 409A valuation service. None of the evidence shows these joined into one end-to-end flow where a board approves the grant and the 409A value sets the strike price. missing for 10: documented board-approval step for option grants, evidence that the 409A valuation automatically sets the grant strike price, a single documented end-to-end issuance workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
